# Build Guide: Bloodstained Commando with Critical Hits and Cripple

![Build Guide: Bloodstained Commando with Critical Hits and Cripple](/uploads/529_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Play Style:** Human | V.A.T.S. | Critical Hits | crippling | High DPS | Bloodstained

On June 3rd, 2025, numerous perk cards were changed again, weapons were buffed and legendary effects were also changed. This opens up new possibilities for builds. Old command builds no longer work 1:1 as before and can be reassembled.

This build is suitable for humans in the **Bloodstained** version, but with small changes it can also be played with full health or as a ghoul. The primary weapons are **automatic rifles** with Bloodstained Mod, but **automatic pistols** are also playable with it. As a bonus for more damage, the build uses **Sneak**, **Critical Hit** and **Cripple**. What's new here is the cripple, which gives us another bonus of up to 345%. This means the build can be played well with or without sneaking, meaning it can also be used in events or daily operations.

*Full Life & Ghoul: Leave out Nerdwut perk, Bloodstained against e.g. Exchange aristocrat, armor e.g. Vanguard instead of unyielding.*

## Weapons

Any automatic rifle or pistol can be used as a weapon. Shotguns are also possible, as these are also considered “small weapons”. In this guide I'm using an assault rifle and an Enclave Plasma Rifle as they are currently among the most powerful automatic rifles in Fallout 76. In principle, you can actually play single-shot rifles with these perks; the options are now more variable than with the old perk cards.

![Bloodstained Enclaves Plasma Rifle (EPR/EPG)](/uploads/nukaknights-post-build-bloodied-crit-cipple-commando-assault-de.png) 

![Bloodstained Assault Rifle](/uploads/nukaknights-post-build-bloodied-crit-cipple-commando-epr-de.png) 

The legendary mods on these two automatic rifles are the same:

1. **Bloodstained** (up to 130% bonus damage at 5% HP)
2. **Explosive** (+20% bonus damage + demolition expert)
3. **Optimized VATS** (-35% action point costs in VATS)
4. **The Bully** (+25% damage per crippled body part of target)*Note: For most enemies this means +150% bonus damage to head, torso, arms, legs. Some enemies have fewer (EN-06) or more "body parts" (Ultracite Horror), the damage then scales accordingly.*

I also tested Vital (+50% damage on critical hits), but Explo usually did better. At short distances, if you want to remain undetected (e.g. in West-Tek), a vital mod instead of explosive can of course make sense. Just test it out for yourself. I currently like the Explo version best.

## Armor

As armor I use Secret Service armor with the mods:

1. Unyielding
2. Powered (3x); Poisoner's (1x), Fireproof (1x)
3. Thru Hikers
4. The Ranger (2x)
 Cross-border (2x)
Of the Rejuvenator (1x)

With this combination the build achieves good SPECIAL values, has good AP acceleration, reduces the weight of chems & food/drinks, increases ranged damage and achieves more critical hits.

## Skillset / Perks

**Strength to 9:** 

| Easy target 3* | *75% more damage
